deliberate_omissions: No aggregateRating on the SoftwareApplication. Google requires ratings to come from real, collectable user reviews; inventing one is a structured-data policy violation and risks a manual action. Add it only when you have genuine reviews, with the count matching what is visible on the page.
No Offer block for ChatGPT. Its pricing did not render to us on 2026-09-10, and asserting a price we could not verify would be a false claim in markup.
No review or Product schema wrapping the competitor. Marking up a competitor as your own Product is misrepresentation.

mainEntity.name: Can't I just ask ChatGPT to audit my landing page?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, and for a one-off look it works well. The difference is repeatability: ChatGPT returns differently-shaped prose each time, while MarketBrain OS returns the same fields every run - a 0-100 score, blockers ranked by severity, and prescriptions ranked by priority - so this month's audit is directly comparable to last month's.

mainEntity.name: Do I need both MarketBrain OS and ChatGPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most teams use both. ChatGPT is better for open-ended thinking, drafting and research. MarketBrain OS is for the moment you need a structured, scored, saved analysis that a team can act on and compare over time.

One analysis run. Each tool states its token cost on the run button before you click, so the cost of a specific task is known in advance rather than governed by message limits. The Free plan includes 20 tokens per month and Pro includes 100.
Scored tools return a 0-100 value mapped to defined bands, alongside structured findings in an insight, evidence and action format, so two runs of the same tool can be compared directly.
